title: bio-raum/FooDMe2 pipeline parameters
description: FooDMe2 Pipeline | Profiling eukaryotic taxa from mitochondrial amplicons

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to tab-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

reads.description: Optional input using regular expressions instead of a sample sheet (discouraged!)

build_references.description: Build the local references for the selected version of the pipeline (requires --reference_base)

binned_qual.description: Reads use binned qualities (Illumina Novaseq, i100, etc)

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

reference_base.description: The local path where the references live

reference_version.description: The version of the references to use (locked to pipeline version by default)

skip_genbank.description: Do not install GenBank core_nt (to safe storage space)

non_overlapping.description: Paired-end reads are not overlapping (large amplicons)

primer_set.description: The pre-configured primer set to use

primers_fa.description: Your amplicon primers in FASTA format

blast_db.description: A custom local blast database to use for taxonomic assignment

blast_low_complexity.description: The low-complexity blast options to use

blast_qcov.description: The Blast query coverage to require

blast_perc_id.description: The minimum Blast percentage of identity

blast_bitscore_diff.description: The maximum allowed Blast bitscore difference to top hit

blast_min_consensus.description: The minimum consensus to assign a taxonomic group from a list of valid hits

db.description: The name of the database to use

taxid_filter.description: The taxonomic group to limit the analysis to (NCBI taxononmy ID)

blocklist.description: A list of taxonomy IDs that are to be masked from the analysis

vsearch_min_cov.description: The minimum coverage allowed in Vsearch

vsearch_cluster_id.description: The identity threshold used for Vsearch clustering

cdhit_cluster_id.description: The identity threshold used for CDHIT clustering (ONT workflow)

amplicon_min_length.description: The minimum length of OTU to be valid

amplicon_max_length.description: The maximum length of OTU to be valid

merging_max_mismatch.description: The maximum allowed mismatch when merging paired-end reads

max_expected_errors.description: The expected error in the read data (depends on technology and read length)

max_ns.description: The maximum number of N bases allowed in the reads

porechop.description: Trim ONT reads with porechop (usually not necessary!)

ont_reads_min_q.description: Minimum phred score of reads to use

benchmark_rank.description: The taxonomic rank to benchmark against4

fastp_options.description: Options used for FastP filtering (Illumina, IonTorrent)

cutadapt_trim_3p.description: Cutadapt requires primer sites both 5' and 3'

cutadapt_trim_flex.description: Cutadapt checks for 3' primer sites but allows read to pass without them

cutadapt_ont.description: Cutadapt checks for primers on both read ends but does not enforce presence

store_reads.description: Store the trimmed reads in the results folder
